# THIS FILE IS AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED BY CARGO
#
# When uploading crates to the registry Cargo will automatically
# "normalize" Cargo.toml files for maximal compatibility
# with all versions of Cargo and also rewrite `path` dependencies
# to registry (e.g., crates.io) dependencies.
#
# If you are reading this file be aware that the original Cargo.toml
# will likely look very different (and much more reasonable).
# See Cargo.toml.orig for the original contents.

[package]
edition = "2024"
name = "get_file_hash_core"
version = "970629.1845.739968"
authors = ["gnostr admin@gnostr.org"]
build = "build.rs"
autolib = false
autobins = false
autoexamples = false
autotests = false
autobenches = false
description = "A utility crate providing a procedural macro to compute and embed file hashes at compile time."
homepage = "https://github.com/gnostr-org/get_file_hash"
documentation = "https://github.com/gnostr-org/get_file_hash#readme"
readme = false
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/gnostr-org/get_file_hash"

[features]
frost = [
    "dep:nostr",
    "dep:nostr-sdk",
    "dep:serde",
    "dep:serde_json",
    "dep:sha2",
    "dep:hex",
    "dep:reqwest",
    "dep:tokio",
    "dep:csv",
    "dep:url",
    "dep:frost-secp256k1-tr",
    "dep:rand",
]
nostr = [
    "dep:nostr",
    "dep:nostr-sdk",
    "dep:serde",
    "dep:serde_json",
    "dep:sha2",
    "dep:hex",
    "dep:reqwest",
    "dep:tokio",
    "dep:csv",
    "dep:url",
    "dep:frost-secp256k1-tr",
    "dep:rand",
]

[lib]
name = "get_file_hash_core"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[example]]
name = "nip-pip"
path = "examples/nip-pip.rs"

[dependencies.csv]
version = "1.3.0"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.frost-secp256k1-tr]
version = "3.0.0-rc.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.hex]
version = "0.4.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.log]
version = "0.4"

[dependencies.nostr]
version = "0.44.2"
features = [
    "std",
    "nip46",
    "nip96",
]
optional = true

[dependencies.nostr-sdk]
version = "0.44.0"
features = [
    "default",
    "pow-multi-thread",
]
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.8"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.219"
features = [
    "alloc",
    "derive",
    "rc",
]
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"
optional = true

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.11.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.url]
version = "2.5.0"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies.csv]
version = "1.3.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.frost-secp256k1-tr]
version = "3.0.0-rc.0"

[dev-dependencies.hex]
version = "0.4.2"

[dev-dependencies.log]
version = "0.4"

[dev-dependencies.nostr]
version = "0.44.2"
features = [
    "std",
    "nip46",
    "nip96",
]

[dev-dependencies.nostr-sdk]
version = "0.44.0"
features = [
    "default",
    "pow-multi-thread",
]
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.219"
features = [
    "alloc",
    "derive",
    "rc",
]
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"

[dev-dependencies.serial_test]
version = "3.4.0"
features = [
    "test_logging",
    "test_logging",
]

[dev-dependencies.sha2]
version = "0.11.0"

[dev-dependencies.tempfile]
version = "3.27.0"

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = [
    "macros",
    "rt-multi-thread",
]

[dev-dependencies.url]
version = "2.5.0"

[build-dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12.0"
features = ["json"]
optional = true
default-features = false

[build-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = [
    "macros",
    "rt-multi-thread",
]
optional = true
